changelog: ✦ Pro Journal Analytics: Single-source engine, interaktif SVG Equity Curve & Underwater Drawdown, filter 7H/30H/90H/Semua, dan metrik R-Multiple.
✦ Integrasi Beranda & Jurnal: Ringkasan performa jurnal di Beranda dengan 4 KPI, quick log, dan evaluasi bareng Amy Live.
✦ TwelveData Multi-Key Pool: Rotasi otomatis multi-key, failover cerdas HTTP 429, dan optimasi kredit API ~80%.
